Hi all — Marcus here (Solutions Architect) — forwarding Marissa's summary and attachments for the technical folks.

Quick technical notes / questions to prepare for the deep-dive:
- Deployment options we propose:
  * Hosted Private VPC: Redwood-managed control plane, customer-managed VPC peering or Transit Gateway; supports private endpoints, VPC flow logs, and KMS integration.
  * Dedicated (reserved): Isolated GPU pools in a customer VPC — predictable throughput and dedicated capacity.
  * On-prem / Air-gapped: Offline installer with HSM/KMS connectors and local audit log delivery. Support for an air-gap requires an approved installation window and on-site infra support.
- KMS/HSM: We support AWS KMS, customer-managed CMKs, and HSM integrations (PKCS#11) for highest assurance. Please tell us preferred KMS provider and whether key escrow is permitted.
- Network: We’ll need the intended VPC CIDR ranges, any proxy/egress constraints, and whether ACME requires forced egress through a transit gateway.
- Throughput/Scaling: Provide expected peak concurrent requests and average context length (tokens) so we can size GPUs and recommend batching/quantization profiles.
- Compliance artifacts: We can provide SOC 2 Type II report (attached), GDPR data processing addendum, and sample BAA for HIPAA. For procurement, I’ll also upload a one-page install checklist to the Drive pack.

Prep items for ACME security/infra:
- Completed SSQ (ACME_SSQ_v1.xlsx)
- Network diagram showing egress rules and any on-prem DMZs
- Data flow diagram identifying where PHI may be stored/processed
